audience: finance and operations teams who extract data from invoices and other documents with Docparser

useCases.title: See which parsers you have set up
useCases.text: The AI lists the document parsers of the account and the model layouts of one parser.

useCases.title: Read the parsed data of recent documents
useCases.text: The AI lists the parsed data of the last uploaded documents of a parser, or of those processed after a date, and opens one for its fields and tables.

useCases.title: Check if a document finished processing
useCases.text: The AI reads a document's status: importing or processing, page count, timestamps and failed jobs.

useCases.title: Import a document from a URL or upload one
useCases.text: The AI sends a document to a parser, either from a public URL or as a small base64 file, and then checks its status.

useCases.title: Re-parse documents after changing the rules
useCases.text: The AI runs a parser again over documents that are already imported, so their parsed data is replaced with the new result.
